venueAddress: Engineering Staff College of India (ESCI), Old Bombay Highway, Gachibowli, Hyderabad, Telangana 500032
description: The inaugural Hyderabad edition of FLEXATHON — The Global Goals Run brought together runners, students, families, and corporate teams at ESCI Gachibowli across 3K, 5K, and 10K categories in support of UN Sustainable Development Goal 4: Quality Education.

raceRules: Winners are determined based on official RFID Gun/Net time verification by the race technical committee.
Participants must wear their assigned official bib visibly on the chest throughout the course and cross all timing mats.
Valid government-issued photo ID is mandatory for podium verification and prize disbursement.
Equal prize money is awarded across Men and Women open categories in both 10K and 5K timed runs.

faq.q: When and where did FLEXATHON 2026 Hyderabad take place?
faq.a: FLEXATHON 2026 Hyderabad took place on Sunday, 18 October 2026 at the Engineering Staff College of India (ESCI) Campus, Gachibowli, Hyderabad.

faq.q: What is the current status of the Hyderabad 2026 edition?
faq.a: The Hyderabad 2026 edition has successfully concluded. Registration is closed, and this edition hub serves as the official historical archive and participant resource centre.

faq.q: What were the race categories and historical entry fees for Hyderabad 2026?
faq.a: Hyderabad 2026 featured three categories: 3K Fun Run (historical entry fee ₹749, 06:45 AM flag-off), 5K Timed Run (historical entry fee ₹999, 06:15 AM flag-off), and 10K Timed Run (historical entry fee ₹1,099, 05:45 AM flag-off).

faq.q: Which Global Goal was highlighted in Hyderabad 2026?
faq.a: Hyderabad 2026 spotlighted UN Sustainable Development Goal 4: Quality Education — advocating inclusive, equitable education and learning opportunities for all.

faq.q: Can Hyderabad 2026 participants still create or download their Runner Card?
faq.a: Yes! Registered Hyderabad 2026 participants can look up their registration by mobile number or upload a photo in the Hyderabad Runner Card Studio (/hydoct18/social-card) to generate and download their commemorative 1254×1254 runner card.

faq.q: Where can I check Hyderabad 2026 race results and certificates?
faq.a: Visit the Hyderabad Results & Certificates page (/hydoct18/results) for official post-race verification updates, or contact the Flexon Sports Foundation helpdesk via WhatsApp (+91 90749 34014) or email (info@flexathonrun.org).
